---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new tool, format support, or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A brief, one-sentence summary of the feature.

## Motivation

Why is this needed? What problem does it solve? Who benefits?

## Detailed Description

Describe the feature in detail. For new format support, include:
- File extension and magic bytes (if known)
- Sample files (if available)
- Reference documentation or prior research

## Proposed Implementation

If you have ideas on how to implement this, describe them here. Pseudocode, algorithm sketches, or library suggestions are welcome.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why were they rejected?

## Additional Context

Links, references, or screenshots that help explain the request.
